notes.title: Updated Glow to version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey folks, we have just updated Glow to version 1.0.3.
This new version includes the following features and fixes:
[list]
    [*]Allow to invert crosshair Y-axis via game settings menu (via "O")
    [*]Updated the mini help screen (via "F1")
    [*]Updated start screen to show all heavy attack modifier keys (Shift/Ctrl/Alt)
    [*]Fixed two minor cosmetic bugs
[/list]
Please let us know if you find anything we should be aware of.
Enjoy!
